115:         if (resourceIs != null) {
116:             try {
117:                 properties.load(resourceIs);
118:                 resourceIs.close();
119:             } catch (IOException e) {
120:                 throw new RuntimeException("Error while reading thumbnailator.properties", e);
121:             }
122:         }
123:     }
124: 
125:     /**
126:      * Clears the internal cache of properties.
127:      * <p>
128:      * This is intended only to be called from tests.
129:      */
130:     static void clear() {
131:         properties.clear();
132:     }
133: 
134:     Configurations(String key) {
135:         this.key = key;
136:     }
137: 
138:     /**
139:      * Returns whether the specified configuration is enabled or not.
140:      * @return  {@code true} if the configuration is enabled, {@code false}
141:      *          otherwise.
142:      */
143:     public boolean getBoolean() {
144:         String propertyValue = properties.getProperty(key);
145:         if (propertyValue != null) {
146:             return Boolean.parseBoolean(propertyValue);
147:         }
148:         return Boolean.getBoolean(key);
149:     }
150: }
